properties.ownership-status: not owned by a public authority
properties.notes: Two inter-connected blocks of flats comprising of 16 units that is now surplus. Identified for redevelopment as part of a renewal of social housing stock which is no longer fit for purpose. Demolition of the existing flats is required. Permission secured for clearance of the site and replacement with 9 houses (19/02706/FUL). The new dwellings are to be 3-bed houses, all for affordable rent. As a result of the clearance, the proposal would result in the overall net loss of 7 dwellings on completion. Development yet to commence but forecast for completion within the next 5 years.
